sections.label: Singles buying 2-room flexi flats
sections.summary: Singles could buy 2-room flexi flats in non-mature estates from July 2013, with supply raised and 40% set aside for elderly applicants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Singles were allowed to buy 2-room flexi flats in non-mature estates from July 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: And to address the strong demand, HDB has increased the 2-room flexi flat supply in non-mature estates from 320 units in 2012 to an average of 4,000 units per year between 2014 and 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Forty percent of 2-room flexi flats are set aside for elderly applicants, including singles aged 55 and above.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The remaining flat supply is divided equally between non-elderly singles and families.

sections.label: Housing grants for singles
sections.summary: Housing grants of up to $55,000 make resale flats more affordable for singles, and joint first-timer singles can get up to $110,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: With housing grants totaling up to $55,000, resale flats have become more affordable for singles.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: First-timer singles buying resale flats jointly can enjoy the same amount of housing grants as first-timer families, which means up to $110,000.

sections.label: Application rate for non-elderly singles
sections.summary: The application rate for non-elderly singles is 6.6, and supply of 2-room flats is being ramped up to clear the backlog.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Today, the application rate for this particular group is 6.6.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: And at an application rate of seven, this means that you have to try several times before you are successful in getting a 2-room flat for the non-elderly singles group.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, the way to resolve this is really to try and ramp up the supply of 2-room flats, which we are doing, and we hope to clear the backlog over the next two years.
